description.en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~610396~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，需要晚于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ* format. The time must be in UTC.**

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
节点ID。
><notice>该参数仅适用于集群版实例，可以选择查询指定节点日志。若不传该参数，默认返回主节点日志。></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the node.

> This parameter is available only for instances that run RDS Cluster Edition. You can specify this parameter to query the logs of a specified node. If this parameter is not specified, the logs of the primary node are returned by default.

description.zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

> 默认值：**1**。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Valid value: **30 to 200**. Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 慢日志统计里的SQL语句唯一标识符，可用于获取该SQL语句的慢日志明细。
description.en: The unique ID of the SQL statement. The ID is used to obtain the slow query logs of the SQL statement.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，最大不能早于当前时间30天。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎

- RDS MySQL
- RDS PostgreSQL
- RDS SQL Server
- RDS MariaDB

### 注意事项

- 本接口的返回参数每分钟更新一次。
- 调用该接口拉取数据时会存在一定延迟，请您耐心等待调用结果的返回。
- 2024年09月01日起，由于SQL的模板化算法优化，调用本接口时，SQLHash字段的值将发生变更。详情请参见[【通知】慢SQL的模板化算法优化](~~2845725~~)。
descriptions.en:
### Supported Engines

- RDS MySQL
- RDS PostgreSQL
- RDS SQL Server
- RDS MariaDB

### Notes

- The response parameters of this API are updated once per minute.
- When you invoke this API to pull data, a certain latency will occur. Please wait patiently for the response.
- Starting from September 1, 2024, due to optimization of the SQL templating algorithm, the value of the SQLHash field will change when you call this API. For more information, see [【Notifications】Optimization of the Templating Algorithm for Slow SQL Statements](~~2845725~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-slow-log-records --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --sql-ha-sh U2FsdGVk0000 --start-time 2020-06-17T16:00Z --end-time 2020-06-18T16:00Z --db-name testdb --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --node-id rn-p1fm78s90x50000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeSlowLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --SQLHASH U2FsdGVk0000 --EndTime '2020-06-18T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2020-06-17T16:00Z' --NodeId 'rn-p1fm78s90x50000' --DBName testdb
